summary: Unbalanced reserve offset after multi-variant fallback during regional autoscale
description: Issue summary: Customer reports a negative reserve credit line and mismatched invoice allocation after a sustained autoscale + regional failover where some requests fell back to a quantized variant. Impact: BrightLayer observed a -$12,450 line on their daily provisional invoice (2026-03-09) representing an apparent reversal of reserved buffer credits that should have been consumed but instead were double-negated. Environment: prod | eu-west primary, fallback to us-central; Dedicated pool ID: ded-eu-08. Timeline: 2026-03-09 02:18 UTC — autoscale spike triggered; 02:23 UTC — routing to quantized variant during temporary capacity shortage; 02:27–02:55 UTC — mixed-variant request stream; 03:05 UTC — provisional invoice generation showing negative reserve credit. Steps to reproduce: 1) Use BrightLayer provided key and replay synthetic traffic (batch of 2k short-chat requests with 128 token typical length) hitting eu-west; 2) Force dedicated pool to scale down artificially to simulate capacity crunch (run failure test in ded-eu-08); 3) Confirm routing policy allows fallback to quantized variant; 4) Observe meter postbacks and reserve-credit consumption in hourly aggregator for window 02:00–03:00 UTC. Expected: reserve credits consumed and charged appropriately; no negative line items. Actual: provisional invoice contains a negative reserve-credit line and subsequent per-token lines show duplicate charge attribution across hosted and dedicated buckets. Logs / important traces: - postback id=pb-20260309-1823 status=200 tenant=brightlayer pool=ded-eu-08 model=gptx-small-fp16-v2 tokens=2480 tariff=reserved-rate - postback id=pb-20260309-1827 status=200 tenant=brightlayer pool=ded-eu-08 model=gptx-small-quantized-v1 tokens=910 tariff=hosted-fallback-rate - aggregator write: hour_window=2026-03-09T02:00Z tenant=brightlayer reserve_delta=-12450 reserve_balance_before=50000 reserve_balance_after=37550 notes=unexpected-negative-offset - billing-service audit: event=apply_reserve_offset txn_id=txn-88a7caf detail="applied -12450 to tenant 42 due to fallback reconciliation" Additional context: Customer has a reserved buffer applied for ded-eu-08; their plan uses a hybrid reserved+hosted fallback policy. They first raised a support chat at 2026-03-09 10:40 local and escalated to CS at 2026-03-09 14:05.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Maya Chen (Reporter): Uploaded provisional invoice screenshot and sample postback JSON. Noted discrepancy only appears in provisional invoice; console estimate prior to 02:00 showed normal usage.
2026-03-10 10:04 - Luca Rossi (Assignee): Acknowledged, starting triage. Requesting access to BrightLayer's postback webhook logs and aggregator commit logs for 2026-03-09 02:00–04:00 UTC.

2026-03-10 12:30 - SRE (Ana Patel): Observed two aggregator commits for the same hour window (commit ids agg-334 and agg-335). agg-335 contains a reserve_delta of -12450 that appears to have been replayed after a partial reconciliation run. Investigating scheduler duplicates.

2026-03-10 15:47 - Billing (Jonah Kim): Found a reconcile-job run (reconcile-window-20260309) that retried with an incremental flag; retry logic failed to mark dedupe token. Related PR that changed idempotency header: github.com/redwood-inference/billing-service/pull/1543 — rolling back for test.

2026-03-11 08:22 - Luca Rossi: Reproduced locally: when reconcile job retries while fallback mapping switches model variant buckets, the reserve-offset record is applied to both 'reserved' and 'fallback' namespaces due to missing namespace normalization in the reconcile step. Patch proposed in route-mapper PR #887 to include pool_id normalization.

2026-03-12 09:01 - Customer (BrightLayer Billing Admin, Elena Ruiz): Confirmed provisional credit on account has been confusing to their finance team. Requested an ETA for provisional correction and whether final invoice will be impacted.

2026-03-12 11:04 - Luca Rossi: Provisional credit of $12,450 submitted as temporary adjustment while we validate final ledger. Target: patch route-mapper and billing-service idempotency check by 2026-03-13, full reconciliation run and final invoice audit by 2026-03-14.
investigation_notes: Checked aggregator history: duplicate commits around 02:27–02:35 UTC with identical fingerprints but different namespace tags (reserved vs fallback).
Scheduler logs show reconcile-job retried with flag `--replay-partial` at 02:40 UTC after a transient SQS timeout; retry path does not set idempotency key X-Idempotency-Token consistently.
Route-mapper returned mapping change during window due to autoscale event: some sessions rehomed from ded-eu-08 -> fallback-hosted-us-central which uses different tariff namespace.

Billing-service applied reserve offset atomically per namespace, but reconciliation step attempted to collapse namespace at final write — race condition led to double-application when duplicate commits existed.
Telemetry: tokenization-normalization change on 2026-03-01 may have altered postback fingerprinting granularity; opened followup ticket INT-1209 to audit fingerprint schema across reconcile runs.
Customer data: BrightLayer's traffic profile included short chats with frequent reconnects (~12% reconnect rate) which increases likelihood of partial replay during scaling events.
Temporary mitigation tested: block reconcile-job retries for aggregate windows with existing finalized commit flag; test prevented double-apply in staging for two-hour simulation.
resolution_notes: Action taken: Applied a provisional customer credit of $12,450 to BrightLayer's account on 2026-03-12 11:00 UTC (ticket adjustment id adj-20260312-67). This is marked as provisional until final ledger reconciliation completes.

Code fixes: route-mapper PR #887 adds explicit pool_id normalization to mapping step; billing-service PR #1543 updated to enforce X-Idempotency-Token presence and to reject duplicate aggregate commits. Both PRs linked above.

Operational: Reconcile scheduler changed to include a guard that prevents `--replay-partial` retries for windows already flagged as committed. Deployed to staging 2026-03-11; candidate rollout to prod on 2026-03-13 after smoke tests.

Customer communication: Notified BrightLayer on 2026-03-12 11:10 UTC with explanation, provisional credit, and planned timeline for final audit. Finance team offered an invoice amendment letter upon completion.

Follow-ups: INT-1209 to audit fingerprinting and postback dedupe; create runbook task to monitor aggregate commit collisions during autoscale events. Schedule postmortem with SRE, Billing, and Route teams for 2026-03-16.

Status: Pending final reconciliation run and verification of no regressions in next 48-hour production window. After verification, provisional credit will be converted to permanent adjustment or rolled back if billing confirms no double-apply.
